scene.note: The shop's reader starts by cutting each supplier list into tokens, and stops at the first character that belongs nowhere.

steps.note: A piece of a supplier list comes in as plain text: brackets, commas and the words true and null.
tokenize walks the text with an index and looks at one character at a time: a mark, or the start of a word.
Each mark and each word becomes a token that says what it is and where it starts and ends.
The paper supplier's list spreads over many lines, with indents and a space after every comma.
Space, tab, line feed and carriage return are stepped over: the index moves on and no token is made.
The tokens still count every character before them, so each one says where it really is in the file.
The card supplier's list comes in, with one name in single quotes.
A single quote starts no token, so tokenize stops there and throws a JsonError instead of skipping it.
Idris now knows which character is wrong and where it sits, and can tell the supplier.
